title: Enchantment Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Located in the center of town, Enchantment is the guest house of the main cottage, Elegance. Just a short stroll to the beach, you will be enchanted by the sugar-white sand beach of the Gulf.
description_expanded: Description161 Smolian Circle1 KING BED, 2 TWINSWelcome to Enchantment – A Cozy Coastal Retreat in Seaside, FloridaTucked away in the peaceful heart of Seaside, Florida, Enchantment is a charming beach cottage that lives up to its name. Thoughtfully designed for relaxation and comfort, this inviting getaway offers a serene retreat just moments from the shoreline and the vibrant town center. Whether you’re planning a romantic escape or a small family vacation, Enchantment provides the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and classic Seaside charm.Comfortable Coastal Living SpacesStep inside to find a warm and welcoming living area filled with coastal-inspired décor and comfortable seating centered around a flat-screen TV with DVD/VCR—ideal for winding down after a sun-soaked beach day. Just beyond the living space, the fully equipped kitchen includes everything needed for effortless meal preparation, while the adjacent dining area comfortably seats four for relaxed meals and conversation.Restful Sleeping QuartersThe main-level primary bedroom offers a peaceful retreat with a king-sized bed and calming décor designed for restful nights. A full hall bathroom with a walk-in shower serves the main floor. For additional guests, a cozy loft space—best suited for children ages 10 and up—features two twin beds tucked beneath soaring vaulted ceilings and accessed via a charming ship’s ladder.Outdoor Living & RelaxationOne of Enchantment’s highlights is its screened-in porch, nestled within a lush, private yard. This tranquil outdoor space includes a loveseat and two club chairs, softly lit for evening relaxation. Whether enjoying morning coffee or an evening glass of wine, the porch offers a peaceful setting to unwind. A private charcoal grill just outside the porch makes al fresco dining easy and enjoyable.Prime Location Near Beach & Town CenterIdeally located just a short stroll from the beach and Seaside’s iconic town square, Enchantment places you within easy reach of sugar-white sands, boutique shopping, local dining, and the vibrant community atmosphere Seaside is known for. Spend your days exploring the coast, biking through town, or soaking in the laid-back charm that makes Seaside such a beloved destination.For additional room, the 5-bedroom cottage, Elegance, may also be rented.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Features576 square feet of thoughtfully designed coastal living352 yards or a 4-minute walk to beach accessSteps from Central Square, offering easy access to shops, dining, and entertainmentSeaside Private Residential Beach at West Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private residential beach on 30AOutdoor shower for convenient post-beach rinsesCharcoal grill for relaxed outdoor mealsAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass included per one-bedroom cottage; a golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001939
